newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Kiat sees 2.5 trln rph from rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Kiat sees 2.5 trln rph from rights issue.

text.p: Indonesian PT Indah Kiat Pulp and Paper Corporation announced on Tuesday it is offering rights to its shareholders to purchase up to 2.5 billion shares attached with up to 448.6 million warrants.

Indah Kiat said in newspaper advertisements that the 50-for-45 rights issue, at a nominal price of 1,000 rupiah per share and an offer price of 1,000 rupiah each, was expected to raise around 2.5 trillion rupiah.
Every 45 new shares are attached with eight warrants provided free of charge, Indah Kiat said.
Each warrant can be used to buy one Indah Kiat share with nominal value and executable price of 1,000 rupiah between January 12, 1998 to July 11, 2002, Indah Kiat said.
Indah Kiat said the proceeds from the rights issue would be used to partly finance the purchase of three paper machines with total annual production capacity of 1.17 million tonnes.
The total cost of the purchase was expected at 3.68 trillion rupiah. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
